title: code.merge-pr output
description: A confirmed merge resolves the step, and the step's output is the plain string this round passes as `next.output` — `submit_step_progress` types `output` as a string, so there is no object here. By convention: "Merged <prUrl>: <one line on what shipped>." Anything short of a merge writes no output at all: it hands back with `next: {kind:"self-round"}` and the blocker in `memo`. Whether the remote branch delete succeeded is best-effort and belongs in `memo`, never in the outcome.
